old_source_probe.status: Independent replay copied only the current test file into committed unfixed source and selected the original twenty-five cases. No fixed panel/helper was copied. Twenty meaningful presentation failures and five controls reproduce the initial local OLD result; the nine expanded cases were deliberately skipped. Older untracked public-business probes were not run. This is not old-source clean package acceptance.

expanded_regression_probe.status: The later nine-case regression probe found two failures before the synchronous single-flight repair. Its seven passes and two failures are separate from the committed OLD twenty-five-case proof. All thirty-four mounted cases pass on tested source.
